solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Police detachment — one of four going after yard in affairs

indicators.note: the piece for one of four follows the first part
the yard abbreviation is placed inside the word for affairs

parts.note: flings are brief love affairs
a quad is a quadruplet, one of four born together

explanation.surface: A police unit chasing a quadruplet tied up in some scandal.
explanation.walkthrough: The FLYING SQUAD is the Metropolitan Police's rapid-response robbery unit in London.
explanation.definitionFit: The Flying Squad is a mobile branch of London's Metropolitan Police, a detachment of officers.

clue.text: Growth of initially great affection, supporting fool

indicators.note: in a down entry the following pieces sit beneath the fool word, holding it up

parts.note: to fox is to fool or baffle

indicators.note: only the opening letter of great is used

parts.note: love means affection

explanation.surface: A sentimental line about a fool propped up by great love.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fool' is a verb here: to fox someone is to fool them.
explanation.definitionFit: A foxglove is a tall flowering plant, so loosely a growth in the garden.

clue.text: Class transforming my year won without women

indicators.note: the remaining letters are changed into a new arrangement
the women abbreviation is taken out of the words my year won

explanation.surface: Someone's triumphant year in a contest that excluded women.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes W from MY YEAR WON, and 'transforming' rearranges what is left, MYYEARON.
explanation.definitionFit: The yeomanry were a social class of small landowning farmers below the gentry.

clue.text: Within earshot, guarding approaches

indicators.note: the words within earshot hold the letters inside them, as if keeping them safe

explanation.surface: Footsteps getting closer while someone stands guard, close enough to hear.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across wiTHIN EARShot; 'Within' looks like the signal but supplies letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To approach something is to come closer to it, so approaches is a synonym.

clue.text: Work hard on answer for catchy phrases

parts.note: to slog is to work hard and doggedly

explanation.surface: Advice on toiling over an answer to come up with memorable slogans.
explanation.definitionFit: Slogans are short memorable lines used in advertising or campaigning, catchy by design.

clue.text: Revealed — not married and not invited

indicators.note: the married abbreviation is left out of the longer word

parts.note: unmasked means exposed or revealed

explanation.surface: A single person exposed and left off the guest list.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' signals dropping M from UNMASKED; the second 'not' belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone not asked to come has not been invited: a guest who was never requested.

clue.text: One takes the lead from vicar's attire

definitions.meaning: a pet's neckband is where the leash clips on
the white clerical band worn round a priest's neck

explanation.surface: A vicar leading the way in his robes.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names both a pet's neckband for a leash and the white band worn by clergy.

clue.text: Mostly reluctant crowd

indicators.note: most of the word is kept, its final letter dropped

parts.note: loth is a spelling of loath, reluctant

explanation.surface: A crowd that is, on the whole, unwilling.
explanation.definitionFit: A lot can mean a group or set of people, as in 'that lot', so a crowd.

clue.text: Hate look on naked swimmer

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look

indicators.note: the swimmer word is stripped of its outer letters, its covering

parts.note: a bather is someone swimming

explanation.surface: Disgust at catching sight of a skinny-dipper.
explanation.definitionFit: To loathe is to detest intensely, a stronger synonym of hate.

clue.text: Topics put up to protect border

indicators.note: the reversed word surrounds the border word, shielding it
in a down entry, up means the word for put is read from the bottom

parts.note: to set is to put or place
a hem is the border of a garment

explanation.surface: Instructions to raise something to guard an edge.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' means read from the bottom; 'to protect' means the reversed word wraps the border.
explanation.definitionFit: Themes are subjects of discussion or writing, the same as topics.

clue.text: Times has changed welcoming love for language

parts.note: x is the multiplication sign, times

indicators.note: the jumbled letters take in the love letter
the letters of has are altered in order

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, O

explanation.surface: A newspaper that has warmly embraced a new language.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changed' rearranges HAS to HSA, and 'welcoming' puts O inside to give HOSA. 'Times' looks like the newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: Xhosa is a Bantu tongue spoken in South Africa, one of its official languages.

clue.text: Poem about variety actor's first drink

indicators.note: the poem word goes round the other pieces

parts.note: an ode is a lyric poem
a range is a variety or assortment

indicators.note: only the initial letter of actor is taken

explanation.surface: A poem about a music-hall performer's first drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Orangeade is a sweet fizzy soft drink flavoured with oranges.

clue.text: Pay attention after hearing only son becomes disreputable businessman

indicators.note: the listening word follows the first two pieces
the word for only is taken as heard, giving a same-sounding spelling

parts.note: lone means sole or only
hark is an old command to listen

explanation.surface: An only son who, after listening, turns into a crook.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hearing' covers only the word for only, so the sound-alike spelling is used; 'after' puts the listening word at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A loan shark lends money at extortionate interest, a shady moneylender.

clue.text: Clay pigment and mineral containing carbon and hydrogen

indicators.note: the mineral word holds the two chemical symbols inside

parts.note: ore is a mineral mined for metal
C is the chemical symbol for carbon
H is the chemical symbol for hydrogen

explanation.surface: A chemistry note on an earthy pigment and a mineral with carbon and hydrogen.
explanation.definitionFit: Ochre is an earthy clay coloured by iron oxide, used as a yellow or brown pigment.

clue.text: Struggles to adopt right universal qualities

indicators.note: the struggles word takes in the other letters

parts.note: vies means competes or struggles
U is the film-rating abbreviation for universal

explanation.surface: Someone's battle to take on good qualities that are right for everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Virtues are good traits of character, positive qualities.

clue.text: Not aware of a Parisian currently held by ruler

parts.note: un is French for a

indicators.note: the ruler word surrounds the currently word

parts.note: a king is a ruler
now means currently

explanation.surface: A French person unaware of something presently in a monarch's grip.
explanation.definitionFit: Unknowing describes someone ignorant of a fact, unaware of it.

clue.text: Idiot daughter's shock going topless

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for daughter

indicators.note: the shock word loses its first letter, its top in an across entry

parts.note: a jolt is a sudden shock

explanation.surface: A father appalled that his daughter has gone topless.
explanation.definitionFit: A dolt is a stupid person, a dunce or idiot.

clue.text: Time in the morning — a danger for this tree

parts.note: a.m. means before noon
a risk is a hazard or danger

explanation.surface: Warning that early hours pose a threat to some tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The tamarisk is a feathery shrub or small tree of coasts and dry places.

clue.text: Left, accepting bishop is yet to lose

indicators.note: the left word takes the bishop letter inside it

parts.note: food left on the plate is uneaten
B is the chess notation for bishop

explanation.surface: A political left wing taking on a bishop and still undefeated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Left' means left over, not the political side.
explanation.definitionFit: A team that has not yet lost a match is unbeaten.

clue.text: Fine reduced to cover end of nuclear plant

indicators.note: the shortened word goes round the final letter
the fine word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: okay means fine or all right

indicators.note: only the last letter of nuclear is used

explanation.surface: A nuclear power station whose fine has been cut to pay for cover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plant' looks like the power station; it is the vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: Okra is a plant grown for its edible green pods, also called ladies' fingers.

clue.text: No secrets, taking everything into account

definitions.meaning: everything has been revealed, nothing held back

explanation.surface: Everything confessed, and every item counted.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both everything having been recounted and, idiomatically, in total.

clue.text: BSE dismissed by submariner suffering BSE!

indicators.note: the letters of submariner are in a poor state, rearranged, once the three dismissed letters are set aside

explanation.surface: A submariner who rejects a cattle disease yet falls ill with it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dismissed by' takes B, S, E from SUBMARINER; 'suffering' rearranges UMARINR. BSE is bovine spongiform encephalopathy, mad cow disease.
explanation.definitionFit: Murrain is an old word for an infectious disease of cattle, so BSE is an example.

clue.text: One may generate an attractive item on love

parts.note: a magnet attracts metal, punning on attractive
love is zero in tennis, O

explanation.surface: A romantic item that might spark something.
explanation.definitionFit: A magneto is a small electrical generator using permanent magnets, as in old ignition systems.

clue.text: Investigated on behalf of graduate teacher

parts.note: pro means for or on behalf of
a BEd is a Bachelor of Education degree

explanation.surface: An inquiry carried out for a qualified schoolteacher.
explanation.definitionFit: Probed means looked into or examined closely, a synonym of investigated.

clue.text: Hooligan's crack about copper's head

indicators.note: the crack word surrounds the other letter

parts.note: a sally is a witty remark, a crack

indicators.note: only the first letter of copper is taken

explanation.surface: A thug mocking a police officer's head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'copper' is British slang for a police officer; SCALLY is northern English slang for a young lout.
explanation.definitionFit: A scally is a roguish young troublemaker in north-west English slang, a hooligan.

clue.text: Man of the cloth mostly getting the right page

indicators.note: the last letter of the clergy word is dropped

parts.note: a rector is a parish priest

explanation.surface: A clergyman who largely gets the correct page in the hymnbook.
explanation.definitionFit: The recto is the right-hand page of an open book.

clue.text: Allege it's criminal to lay down laws

indicators.note: the letters are treated wrongly, disordered

explanation.surface: Claiming it is a crime to make new laws.
explanation.definitionFit: To legislate is to make or enact laws for a country.

clue.text: Profiles banks

definitions.meaning: outlines or faces seen from one angle
the edges of a river or slopes

explanation.definitionFit: Both words name edges or aspects: a face seen side-on and a river's edges.

clue.text: Indian customs mainly seen in American city

parts.note: a balti is a dish served in Indian restaurants in Britain

indicators.note: most of the customs word is kept, its last letter dropped

parts.note: mores are the customs of a society

explanation.surface: Indian traditions found largely in a US city.
explanation.walkthrough: A balti is a curry cooked and served in a metal bowl, popular in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Baltimore is a major port city in Maryland, USA.

clue.text: Believer bound for rejection hugs son

indicators.note: the turned word wraps round the son letter
the bound word is turned back

parts.note: tied means bound

explanation.surface: A tied-up believer hugging a son who is rejected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for rejection' turns TIED into DEIT, which 'hugs' S.
explanation.definitionFit: A deist believes in a creator god without revealed religion, a kind of believer.

clue.text: Air could be dirty without it

definitions.note: an adjective that may describe air

indicators.note: the two letters are taken out of the word dirty

explanation.surface: A remark about air pollution: lacking something, air turns filthy.
explanation.definitionFit: Air lacking moisture is described as arid, so the definition gives an example of such an adjective.

clue.text: Maker so far out, knowledge is abandoned

parts.note: the Maker is God, the creator

indicators.note: the letters of so far are put out of order

parts.note: ken means range of knowledge

explanation.surface: A creator so remote that knowledge has been given up.
explanation.definitionFit: A godforsaken place is desolate and neglected, abandoned.
